text: `` I promise, as soon as we get these brakes looked at we can have that cinnamon roll.'' It is rare that the Protector does n't get them their treat of choice after finally getting them to go deal with something. The biggest thing a Protector ever has to help with is helping the one they are protecting get out of a relationship where they are not safe. The joy they feel when the `` little one'' finally believes they will get those cinnamon rolls after all the `` oh sweetie'' and going back to what they were doing.
